purpose: Teach: 言い換えれ/気がつき/いっさい/ズバリ/いつしか/まいる/解る/はなはだ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、難しい問題は言い換えれば分かるぞ
lines.en: Riku, you know if you rephrase hard problems you can actually understand them.
lines.style: Casual coaching tone, slight lean forward. Genuine belief underneath the matter-of-factness. Not lecturing—just stating what she knows works.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで間違いに気がつきまして修正できたな、桜
lines.en: You actually caught your mistake on the test and fixed it, Sakura. That's sharp.
lines.style: Steady, sincere. Light emphasis on the recognition itself. Warm without overdoing it. Eyes steady—not performing praise, just delivering it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、いっさい説明しないで答えだけ書くなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't just write the answer without explaining your work next time, okay?
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. Quick tempo on the instruction. Testing whether he'll actually listen or brush it off. Underlying care in the directness.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ズバリ俺の弱点ついてくるな、桜
lines.en: You're hitting exactly where I'm weak, aren't you? Pretty sharp, Sakura.
lines.style: Slight wry smile in the voice. Caught-off-guard but not defensive. Rueful acknowledgment that she saw through him. Pace slightly slower on the admission.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、いつしか俺ら高三だな
lines.en: Weird to think we're third-year students now, Riku.
lines.style: Quieter, almost to herself. Slight wonder underneath. Not quite belief yet. Trailing off like the weight of it is just landing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のところにまいるけど、いいか?桜
lines.en: I was thinking of stopping by your place. That okay?
lines.style: Casual opener but slight hesitation underneath—checking whether the ask is welcome. Even tone, not too eager. Genuinely asking, not assuming.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のテスト点、なんで解るんだ?
lines.en: How did you even know what I got on that test, anyway?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with an edge of suspicion. Quick tempo on the question. Not accusatory—actually interested in the answer. Leans slightly forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、はなはだ自信過剰だぞ、桜
lines.en: You're way too confident, aren't you? Kind of a lot, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware tone. Small laugh underneath. Not criticizing—more like he's caught her doing the thing she always does. Warm underneath the wryness.
